title: Gratis Core Windows 11 build prerequisites

target.notes: Windows 10 may run the app but is not a supported build target.

node.notes: Node.js x64 is required to load the 64-bit ONNX Runtime and Electron binaries.

python.notes: The py launcher is preferred on Windows. Python is optional if Whisper setup is skipped.

cpu.notes: Native binaries are built for AVX2/FMA3 with AES-NI. AVX-512 is never enabled (it would crash non-AVX-512 CPUs).

gpu.notes: Embeddings use DirectML (bundled with onnxruntime-node on win32/x64). Whisper needs a CUDA 12.8+ PyTorch wheel; the setup script installs it inside the venv. No global CUDA install or PATH edit is required for Gratis itself.

disk.notes: CUDA PyTorch wheel (~2.8 GB download, ~8 GB installed), Whisper model (~140 MB), Electron/app assets and installer.

network.notes: Used by npm ci, the Electron binary, semantic-encoder assets and the CUDA Whisper wheels.

options.effect: Create the isolated .venv-whisper CUDA runtime without prompting.
Override the Gratis data directory used for the venv and voice-runtime.json.
Reuse existing node_modules instead of running npm ci.
Print checks and planned steps without executing them.

agentNotes: Keep this file in sync with scripts/setup-win.mjs and docs/BUILD_WINDOWS.md.
All checks are local and read-only; the bootstrapper never edits the registry, shell profile or global PATH.
The bootstrapper is safe to re-run: dependency, asset and Whisper setup steps are idempotent.
